# tshapedconsultant — Andrés Lage Freire

> AI Governance Engineering: executable controls, lifecycle gates and verifiable evidence across the AI lifecycle.

Andrés Lage Freire designs and governs DGOM™ and Dédalo™. Based in Madrid · Working remotely across EMEA. The practice helps organisations deploying RAG, agents and other high-consequence AI systems turn regulation, policy and risk controls into runtime assurance.

This site was designed and built by Andrés with AI-assisted coding, treating accessibility, privacy, performance and auditability as first-class constraints.

DGOM™ orchestrates governance frameworks. It does not replace legal advice, formal certification or an organisation’s accountable decision-makers.
